cohort: The study included 50 primiparous women from Murho PHC, Madhepura, Bihar, categorized into younger (<=25 years) and older (>25 years) mothers.
finding: Maternal age significantly impacts obstetric and neonatal outcomes in primiparous women, with older mothers experiencing higher rates of cesarean delivery and neonatal complications.
mod_finding: Older mothers experienced a higher rate of cesarean deliveries (40%) compared to younger mothers (20%).
birth_weight: Measured as an outcome; average 3.2 kg for younger mothers and 2.9 kg for older mothers.
gest_age: Measured as an outcome; average 39 weeks for younger mothers and 38 weeks for older mothers.
